headline: World Bank Warns of Food Crisis as 2026 Commodity Prices Seen Surging 23%
summary: The World Bank forecasts a 23% jump in global commodity prices in 2026, with energy costs rising 32% and food prices climbing amid the war involving Iran and El Niño weather risks.
why: The World Bank is an international financial institution that monitors poverty and commodity markets. Surge forecasts in food and energy signal elevated risks for global inflation and import costs.

impacts.name: Global commodity index
impacts.why: The World Bank projects a 23% rise in overall commodity prices driven by energy and food markets.
